title: Another device's email capture is not seen until reload
evidence: Closed 2026-11-25 (owner ruling): latent; reload heals. State is read once per mount; widget-src/src/components/PlanPdf.tsx:188-199 useEmailCaptureState reads getReportEmailCaptured() once (startState), again only on an erase reset; nothing re-reads it on a remote change
